prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game SPRITE ATLAS for an original PRIME INTELLECT-inspired fighter in Sandbox Wars, a cyberpunk pixel-art street fighting website. The attached reference is a WEBSITE MOOD reference only: dark misty forest, ferns, a luminous rectangular amber-edged mirror/portal, water, muted natural greens. Do NOT reproduce website, text, scenery, portal on ground, or background. Translate those motifs into ONE strange human streetwear COSPLAYER character.

CHARACTER: a quirky adult androgynous human 'techno-druid' forest-rave cosplayer. Slim somewhat lanky, warm freckled face, shaggy copper-red hair. A distinctive tall narrow RECTANGULAR TRANSLUCENT AMBER-FRAMED VISOR strapped over face like a wearable portal; human eyes faintly visible through dark green glass, softly pale gold edges, not an opaque robot face. Large charcoal headphones behind visor strap. Cropped asymmetrical deep FOREST-TEAL waterproof poncho, textured moss-green fabric fringes on one shoulder and two small real-looking FERN SPRIGS tucked into shoulder webbing, all touching garment. Underneath modern black technical long-sleeve streetwear with copper wrist circuitry. Loose slate knee-length utility shorts over black leggings, chunky dark weatherproof high-top sneakers with muted copper accents. Small folded reflective emergency-blanket strips hanging from belt evoke forest portal. Human anatomy. Natural cosplay meets underground cyberpunk rave; not a fantasy elf, medieval druid or armored warrior. No staff, sword, antlers, wings, tail, floating leaves or magic effects. Palette dark pine/teal, moss, muted copper-gold, wet-slate gray; NOT neon lime raincoat, green crystalline armor, black business suit, magenta mask, or orange industrial gear.

VISUAL STYLE: beautifully crafted original 16-bit arcade pixel art, visible square clusters, sharp stepped contours, dark outlines, restrained shading ramps. Same approximate anatomical detail as a late-1990s street-fighter sprite. No blurry painterly edges, no photorealism, no vector cartoon.

ATLAS: square transparent PNG with exactly NINE equal square cells, strict 3 columns × 3 rows. True alpha transparency. No text, labels, borders, grid, background, floor, scenery, checkerboard drawing, or shadows. At least 7% clear padding on every cell edge. Each figure stays wholly inside its cell. Every full-body frame faces RIGHT in three-quarter view, consistent body scale, feet aligned to 90% cell height, max standing height 80% of cell including visor and ferns. All gear attached to body, no detached props.

FIRST SIX CELLS in top two rows: CLEAN idle loop, six subtly different frames. Slightly awkward offbeat dancing stance, knees loose, one hand holding headphone cup near ear, other hand open at waist as if feeling a rhythm. Modest shoulder sway and tiny knee bend, feet planted, same exact costume, head size and proportions in all six. Calm dreamy expression through visor, pristine before fight. Not a boxing guard or meditating pose. No damage or bandages.

BOTTOM LEFT: BATTERED aftermath, seated cross-legged in a defeated hunch, both hands cupping the slipped rectangular visor now at chest height while still attached by neck strap, hair messy, one fern bent, poncho scuffed, little cheek adhesive bandage, looking sadly down at scratched visor. Make the human face readable here. No blood, no gore.

BOTTOM CENTER: BATTERED VICTORY, standing tired, visor pushed crookedly up onto forehead revealing weary freckled face, one hand trying to straighten the bent fern shoulder decoration, other hand on hip, small embarrassed smile, same cheek bandage and scuffed poncho. No fist overhead, no peace sign or thumbs-up. A funny person trying to put their cosplay back together.

BOTTOM RIGHT: CLEAN enlarged head-and-shoulders portrait of identical character, copper shaggy hair, tall amber rectangular glass visor over face with subtle green forest-like reflection, headphones, shoulder fern and teal poncho. No injuries or bandages. Portrait fully inside cell with padding.

All nine images must depict exactly the same character. Sprite atlas only.
